verdict.rationale: Slate's core interface is a natural-language chat/TUI where users type instructions like "Please review the architecture of my entire codebase..." and it plans/executes across tools, models, and sessions (docs-6, docs-2, docs-13). This is documented as the primary operating mode alongside slash-commands and shortcuts, confirming natural-language control is fully supported. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that NL commands reliably produce correct results (community evidence only critiques output quality on a specific porting task, not the NL-interaction mechanism itself).
